title: Q3 Wrap: 92 Days to Max Your 2026 Roth
subtitle: Q3 ends Sept 30. Q4 starts Oct 1. 92 days remain to fund your 2026 Roth — the deadline isn't Dec 31, it's April 15, 2027.
source_irs: IRC §219(c) (Roth IRA contribution deadline); IRC §219(f)(3) (spousal IRA); IRC §4973 (6% excise tax)

concepts.heading: The 92-Day Clock
concepts.lede: Q3 ends Sept 30. Q4 starts Oct 1. You have 92 days left to max your 2026 Roth — and the deadline isn't Dec 31.
body: Today: Sept 28, 2026. Q3 ends Wed, Sept 30, 2026.
Q4 starts Thu, Oct 1, 2026 and runs 92 days to Dec 31, 2026.
The 2026 Roth IRA contribution deadline is April 15, 2027 — not Dec 31.
Most people think Dec 31 is the deadline. It's not. You have until tax day of the following year.

concepts.heading: The Room You Have
concepts.lede: If you've contributed $0 so far in 2026, you have the full $7,500 of room. If you've contributed $3,000, you have $4,500 left.
body: $15,000 — 2026 spousal Roth if both spouses contribute the max (Roth + spousal Roth).
The 6% excise tax (IRC §4973) applies to ANY excess — including contributions over the cap.

concepts.heading: The 3-Step Action
concepts.lede: Three steps in Q4 max the 2026 Roth. Step 1 takes ten minutes. Step 2 takes an hour. Step 3 is a calendar reminder.
body: Step 1: Log into your Roth account today. Note the year-to-date contribution. Subtract from $7,500. That's your remaining room.
Step 2: Fund the remaining room in one lump sum on Oct 1, 2026. Time in market beats dollar-cost averaging in Q4.
Step 3: Set a calendar reminder for April 1, 2027 to do a final 2026 contribution if you have leftover room from a bonus or side income.
